recognize_zh: 箭頭標示多個核呈腎形或馬蹄形、旁邊有嗜酸性核旁區的 hallmark cells，大箭頭指向核呈環狀（doughnut cell），加上核分裂與夾雜嗜酸性球，是 ALCL 的經典形態。
features: Sheets of large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and vesicular chromatin
Hallmark cells (small arrows) with eccentric reniform or horseshoe-shaped nuclei and an eosinophilic paranuclear Golgi region
Doughnut cell (large arrow) with a ring-shaped nucleus surrounding a cytoplasmic pseudoinclusion
Distinct nucleoli and several mitotic figures
Interspersed eosinophils and residual myeloid cells; loose edematous stroma at upper right
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows sheets of large neoplastic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli, with several mitotic figures. Numerous hallmark cells with eccentric horseshoe- or kidney-shaped nuclei and eosinophilic paranuclear regions are identified (small arrows), along with a doughnut cell with a ring-shaped nucleus (large arrow). Scattered eosinophils and residual myeloid precursors are intermixed. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma, pending confirmation with CD30 and ALK immunostains.

ddx.vs: Reed-Sternberg cells have large eosinophilic nucleoli, are scattered rather than sheeted, and are CD15+/PAX5 weak and ALK negative.
Carcinoma lacks hallmark cells and is cytokeratin positive with negative CD30 and ALK.
DLBCL expresses CD20/PAX5 and lacks uniform CD30 and ALK.
PTCL-NOS lacks the uniform strong CD30 expression and characteristic hallmark cells, and is ALK negative.
